projects.name: Daedalus
projects.summary: Local-first LLM application built on Ollama
description: Developed a local-first LLM application built on Ollama to improve self-hosted model usability while preserving data privacy
Prevented memory leaks in LLM processes using a thread-safe job manager, handling lifecycles via sync.Map and context.WithCance
Decreased latency by ∼50% by implementing real-time data streaming for concurrent model downloads and chat generation

projects.name: Intervu
projects.summary: AI-powered career planning and interview platform
description: Developed Built a career planning platform utilizing Google Gemini and GCP Speech-to-Text for mock interviews and resume optimization
Designed 10+ unit tests to validate endpoints and data formatting, leveraging Swagger for interactive testing and documentation

projects.name: Aegis Realty
projects.summary: AI-powered real estate investment and property management platform
description: Integrated Google Gemini to analyze property data and generate plain-language investment evaluations using Cap Rate metrics
Reduced average load times by ∼20% by configuring stale-while-revalidate caching with TanStack Query to cut redundant API calls
Extracted, transformed, and loaded 10,000+ property records into PostgreSQL via paginated API requests and Python scripting

projects.name: ORDSS Writing Challenge
projects.summary: Interactive writing time tracker designed for Villanova's Office of Research Development & Scholarship Support
description: Devised a fail-tolerant writing time tracker for 50+ Villanova faculty to preserve session data through unexpected interruptions
Spearheaded Agile sprints and task delegation, translating stakeholder needs into a 10-page roadmap and streamlining development
